{{ElectionsOR}}

The '''2026 Oregon gubernatorial election''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[governor of Oregon]]. [[Democratic Party of Oregon|Democratic]] incumbent [[Tina Kotek]] is seeking a second term. She is being challenged by 2022 [[Oregon Republican Party|Republican]] gubernatorial nominee [[Christine Drazan]]. 

[[Primary elections]] took place on May 19, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|date=May 9, 2025 |title=2026 State Primary Election Dates|url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|website=[[National Conference of State Legislatures]]|access-date=August 5, 2025}}</ref> Kotek won the Democratic nomination with 84% of the vote, while Drazan won the Republican nomination with 41% of the vote.

This election will mark Oregon's first gubernatorial rematch since [[1978 Oregon gubernatorial election|1978]].
